title: TravelRuleProofResponse
description: A wallet ownership proof for a self-hosted wallet recipient. The microtransfer instruction fields are present only while a PENDING microtransfer test awaits its on-chain deposit.

walletAddress.description: The wallet address the proof covers.

chain.description: The blockchain of the wallet address (for example `ETH` or `TRON`).

status.description: Lifecycle status of the proof. PENDING applies only to microtransfer tests awaiting their deposit; EXPIRED means the validity window has passed; INVALIDATED means the recipient's Travel Rule data changed after the proof was collected.

expiresAt.description: For a VERIFIED proof, when it expires. For a PENDING microtransfer test, the deadline for the test deposit to arrive.

expectedAmount.description: Microtransfer tests only — the exact amount to send from the wallet being proven.

expectedCurrency.description: Microtransfer tests only — the currency of the test transfer.

destinationAddress.description: Microtransfer tests only — the address to send the test transfer to (the beneficiary's own Caliza wallet; the test amount is credited to the beneficiary's balance).
